sql:
SELECT r.year, r.round, d.driver_id, d.constructor_id,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) 
        FROM results res 
        WHERE res.race_id = r.race_id AND res.driver_id = d.driver_id) as had_result
FROM drives d
JOIN races r ON r.year = d.year
WHERE d.year = 1950
ORDER BY d.year, d.driver_id, r.round
LIMIT 50
